pages.quiz:
GRADE 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
Time: 30 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Properties of Matter in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. a) categorise substances in the environment into the three states of matter,
   B. Learners should ignore Properties of Matter completely.
   C. Properties of Matter is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Properties of Matter.

2. About Properties of Matter around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. b) describe the properties of the three states of matter,
   B. Learners should ignore Properties of Matter completely.
   C. Properties of Matter is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Properties of Matter.

3. About Properties of Matter in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. a) classify solid waste into decomposable and non- decomposable,
   B. Learners should ignore Properties of Matter completely.
   C. Properties of Matter is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Properties of Matter.

5. About Water Conservation in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. a) explain the meaning of water conservation in the environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Water Conservation completely.
   C. Water Conservation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water Conservation.

6. About Water Conservation around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. b) describe methods of conserving water at home and school,
   B. Learners should ignore Water Conservation completely.
   C. Water Conservation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water Conservation.

7. About Water Conservation in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. c) outline the importance of conserving water at home and school,
   B. Learners should ignore Water Conservation completely.
   C. Water Conservation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water Conservation.

9. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

10. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

11. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

12. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Properties of Matter in your school compound.
